definition.profile: STAND Playbook: rules learned from recorded outcomes
definition.scope: The rules STAND works by, each proposed from real Matter outcomes and adopted or retired only by the Chairman.

roles.steward: STAND itself, which proposes rules from the outcomes it has recorded.
roles.chairman: The person with authority to adopt or retire a rule. Nothing enters the playbook without this signature.

definition.boundary: This playbook records rules STAND proposed from recorded outcomes and which of them the Chairman adopted or retired. Evidence cites events in separate Matter records; check those records on their own. Adopting a rule is a governance decision, not a promise that it fits every situation.
